ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A food web is shown. Animals that survive on the flesh of other animals are called what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image title is “Food Web”. In the upper part of the figure there are animals such as fox, lion, and wolf, and arrows connect to animals such as chicken, monkey, and squirrel; in the lower part there are also food sources such as wheat, banana, and acorn. On the left side there are classification boxes, among which the text in the upper red box is not spelled standardly and seems to indicate meat-eating consumers, the middle box indicates herbivore consumer, and the bottom box indicates producer. Then reason: The question asks, “What are animals that live on the meat of other animals called?” In biological vocabulary, animals that eat meat or eat other animals are called carnivores. Therefore the answer is Carnivores.
